assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original rural medieval pixel-art review board with TWO small quest spaces. Reference for muted earth stone timber and thatch only, no full town copy. Coarse chunky pixels, restrained grey brown olive, top-down oblique orthographic, horizontal walls vertical posts square-grid ground, no diamond-isometric. LEFT low memorial side arcade at foot of modest slope. One weathered stone tablet with a shallow indistinct old ANIMAL RELIEF carved FLAT IN STONE, clearly inert sculpture, never a live beast or resurrection. Beside it two smaller separate plain witness tablets with differing simple abstract marks, and one empty inset witness slot. No names, heroic conclusion or funeral body. Public path bypasses slope completely. RIGHT ordinary aid pavilion at street level with its OWN open front, accessible directly from broad level path without crossing memorial area. Table has several separate generic livestock-loss tally shapes and a modest closed aid pouch, empty small shelf compartments visibly limit resources, no money piles. No people, ceremony queue, family names, writing, labels, watermark or supernatural light. The tableau doesn't settle conflicting testimony or establish any completed aid payment. Independent dry return routes clear in both panels.
assets.qa: Inert flat stone animal relief, two distinct side tablets and empty witness inset rendered. Aid pavilion has independent level street approach and modest closed pouch. Generator added distant ordinary grazing livestock; no live legendary beast or attack. No private names/readable claims. Relief/tablet motifs are original proposals, not validated canon; aid counts do not prove payment.

Short rope strung high between two fixed posts with three ordinary loose wooden rattles, a plainly visible hand-pull loop safely at side, no trap or weapon. Broad empty safe observation lane does not cross the rope; some small ordinary animal paw depressions in mud below fence, separate clean high stone patch with NO human footprints. No beast or new attack. RIGHT replica-medallion mould workshop with independent OPEN street doorway. Small old two-piece casting mould OPEN on cool wooden workbench, one visibly fresh dull metal sample beside it with new casting seam; small blank tag set on its own stand represents replica label to be typeset later. Closed modest refund pouch separate, no completed refund. Cold hearth, tools stored, no molten metal or production hazard. No historic original stolen, no conclusion about old heroism. No characters, magic, text, numbers, labels or watermark. Clear independent ground-level exits and neutral daytime inspection state.
assets.qa: Daylight three-rattle rope with side pull loop and clear observer lane rendered, separate low ordinary paw marks and high clean patch. Mould room independently open with cool two-part mould, fresh blank sample and empty tag. Two sheep added behind fence, not attacked. Replica wording intentionally not typeset; label remains unresolved before any production sale. No magic or old beast resurrection.

LEFT quiet bell axle repair pavilion with ONE ordinary small bronze bell safely at rest on low padded work cradle, NOT ringing, shaft and a detached worn wooden bushing set on table beside it. ONE removable simple commemorative pendant lies separately in tray, several blank time-slot wooden tallies, hand tools stored. Bell should be modest village scale, not grand church tower or magic. Wide public path bypasses pavilion without operating bell. RIGHT separate everyday assistance awning on LEVEL public street with its OWN wide open front; low counter holds TWO distinctly separated trays of small WOODEN tokens: one set has round punched holes, the other has triangular punched holes. assets.qa: Quiet ordinary bell rests on padded cradle with detached axle/bushing and pendant; public bypass and independent level aid counter clear. Two tray groups distinguished by ROUND versus TRIANGULAR TOKEN SHAPES rather than merely differing holes; identity coding concept works but exact required hole silhouette needs production correction. No completed payout/attendance inferred.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Targeted edit of this two-panel pixel-art image. Change ONLY the short STONE STEPS outside the open right-side doorway of RIGHT withdrawal shelter. Replace all step risers with a clearly continuous GENTLE DRY EARTH-AND-STONE RAMP, smooth sloping paved surface with NO stairs, extending down and outward along the right side to join public path. Widen the clear ramp bottom landing so an empty rescue stretcher could pass. Preserve doorway OPEN, preserve separate side passage, shelter table bench wage pouch and shift trays. Keep entire LEFT mine rope shelter, stretcher, safety rail, lamps and original composition unchanged. Do not add people, payment, rescue outcome or medical claims. Keep coarse muted pixel art, same camera and palette, no text. The intended single correction is accessible gradual ground ramp at the right shelter's side exit, not more stair steps.
assets.qa: Side steps replaced with continuous shallow paved slope and wider dry path connection, doorway remains open. Left mine/stretcher and main right props preserved broadly, not pixel exact. Prefer v2. Ramp gradient, stretcher clearance and exact collision still unverified.
